name: SigMF Raw-IQ Capture Ingest Flow
description: Per-provider ingest flow, raw-IQ capture pointers (typed contracts 1.0: every edge carries one FlatBuffers type; no JSON or base64 travels between nodes): a cron TIMER tick (TimerTick) enters at sigmf-captures:request, which emits ONE bulk HttpRequest GET of the configured archive's metadata index (default IQEngine https://www.iqengine.org/api/datasources/local/local/meta — anonymous, no token) rather than a per-file crawl of a community-run service, its parse job in CONTEXT (one size-prefixed IngestRequest skeleton: schema IQC.fbs, provider, the adapter's source name, source URL, reconcile None, archive naming). hostcap/http-request answers the HttpResponse with the job echoed, so request and job are never paired by position. sigmf-captures:parse resolves the source adapter from the job's source name (an unknown one fails closed), reads the archive coordinates from the same node CONFIG the request used, and emits a size-prefixed $IQC record stream (batch = sha256 of the payload; SigMF hertz carried unconverted; DATATYPE verbatim; GEOLOCATION omitted when unpublished and REFUSED when the coordinates are out of WGS-84 range; licence per RECORDING, empty meaning unknown terms, so the batch tags name no licence), the IngestRequest and the HttpResponse verbatim as the raw document, and hostcap/storage-ingest persists the batch through the policy-mediated storage.ingest_with_source hostcall (typed $PIV), archiving the raw index as sigmf/<adapter>-meta.json. $IQC is a POINTER RECORD: PAYLOADS carry the upstream URLs and hashes with CUSTODY UPSTREAM_ONLY, so no capture payload is ever mirrored by this flow. Egress: result (IngestResult), notice (FlowNotice). HTTP 304 Not Modified is a successful run with nothing new, not a failed fetch: the parse node emits one FlowNotice (Unchanged, not-modified) on its 'unchanged' port straight to the egress notice port and no meta/records/raw frames, so storage-ingest never fires and no batch is stored or announced. All decisions live in-wasm; the host supplies only the http and storage connectors.

triggers.description: SigMF archive sync timer. WEEKLY: these archives grow by hand-contributed recordings over weeks, and one cycle pulls a ~31 MB index from a free community deployment, so a daily poll would be abuse with no new data to show for it.
